mdbx: release v0.13.11 "A7A5" (just as Stable).

The supporting release of a stable branch with bug fixes.

Since 2026 libmdbx project has changed its code development and distribution model.
Please see https://libmdbx.dqdkfa.ru/release/libmdbx-roadmap-HNY2026-english.pdf

 - Fixed using of the identifier `ERROR_UNHANDLED_ERROR`, which is not defined in new versions of Windows SDK.
 - Fixed non-closing of DBI descriptors for tables created in nested transactions when such transactions are aborted.
 - Fixed extra msync/fsync operations during GC reclaiming in a full database.
 - Fixed suboptimal reducing/merging of histogram items in an output of the `mdbx_chk` tool.
 - Fixed cursor(s) finalization after ones explicitly closed in a nested transactions.

For more information please see [ChangeLog](https://sourcecraft.dev/dqdkfa/libmdbx/browse/ChangeLog.md?rev=stable) in the `stable` branch.

The supporting release of a stable branch with bug fixes.

Since 2026 libmdbx project has changed its code development and distribution model.
Please see https://libmdbx.dqdkfa.ru/release/libmdbx-roadmap-HNY2026-english.pdf

 - Fixed the counting of nested trees in the `mdbx_chk` tool for a multi-values/dupsort hives (backport).
 - Fixed swapping the shrink/growth parameters in a DB-geometry in the `mdbx_load` utility (backport).
 - Fixed `SIGSEGV` in the case when all meta pages are not entirely usable (backport).
 - Fixed information collection via `kstat()` for bootid on Solaris and related platforms (backport).
 - Fixed a typo in the `ST_EXPORTED` processing path that broke the build on platforms where the mentioned flag is defined for `fstatvfs()` (backport).
 - Fixed missing error handling of `NtUnmapViewOfSection()` and `munmap()` inside `osal_munmap()` (backport).

 - Fixed returning a wrong/uninitialized `ms_psize` field when using `mdbx_enumerate_tables()` (backport).
 - Fixed adjusting of neighbor nested cursors after a dupsort item deletion (backport).

For more information please see [ChangeLog](https://sourcecraft.dev/dqdkfa/libmdbx/browse/ChangeLog.md?rev=stable) in the `stable` branch.

mdbx: fix MDBX_opt_presync_threshold using min_unsigned() instead of max_unsigned()

Both the mdbx_env_set_option() setter (case MDBX_opt_presync_threshold)
and the internal read site in env_sync() clamp the threshold with
min_unsigned(value, 1), which forces the effective threshold to at most
1 page for any configured value — collapsing every configured
presync-threshold to its floor instead of applying a floor.

The sibling clamp_unsigned() helper in mdbx-internals.h composes
max_unsigned() then min_unsigned() (floor-then-ceiling), confirming
max_unsigned(x, 1) — "at least 1 page" — was the intended floor here,
not min_unsigned(x, 1) which instead imposes "at most 1 page".

Fix: use max_unsigned() in both places.

Verified with a standalone harness against the built library: before
the fix, mdbx_env_set_option(env, MDBX_opt_presync_threshold, 10 MiB)
followed by mdbx_env_get_option() incorrectly returned 4096 bytes
(exactly 1 page); after the fix it correctly returns 10485760 bytes.
The default (262144) and other edge values round-trip correctly with
no regressions.
